items.title: Purple Floral Dress Garden Portrait
items.prompt:
Create a photorealistic outdoor portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a young woman standing in a lush green garden or woodland setting, captured from a three-quarter rear angle as she gently turns her head toward the camera"}. She has long, thick dark brown hair styled in a high ponytail, with a few soft face-framing strands falling naturally around her cheeks. Her skin has a warm, natural complexion with subtle realistic texture, soft highlights, and an even sun-kissed appearance. Her expression is calm, confident, and composed, with a relaxed gaze directed toward the camera and a subtle closed-mouth smile.

She is wearing {argument name="outfit" default="an elegant purple patterned sleeveless dress with thin shoulder straps, a fitted upper silhouette, and a flowing full-length skirt"}. The fabric should have a detailed organic floral or abstract print in multiple shades of purple, with realistic folds, stitching, and natural fabric texture. Keep the outfit tasteful, refined, and fashion-editorial. Add minimal accessories, such as small understated earrings, while keeping the overall styling clean and natural.

{argument name="background" default="The subject is standing among dense green foliage, slender hanging branches, leafy plants, and soft woodland vegetation. The background should feel immersive and natural, with layered greenery extending into the distance"}. Include subtle patches of earth, scattered leaves, and softly blurred vegetation to create depth without distracting from the subject. Use warm late-afternoon natural sunlight filtering through the leaves, producing gentle highlights along the hair and shoulders, soft directional illumination on the face, and delicate dappled light throughout the scene. Maintain realistic shadows and a balanced exposure.

Compose the image as a high-end lifestyle and fashion photograph shot on an 85mm portrait lens at approximately f/2.0, with a shallow depth of field and smooth natural background bokeh. Use a flattering perspective, precise focus on the eyes and face, realistic skin texture, fine hair detail, accurate fabric texture, and natural proportions. The camera should be positioned slightly above waist level, with enough environmental context to show the surrounding greenery while keeping the subject visually dominant. Apply a cinematic color grade with rich but natural greens, refined purple tones, warm skin tones, soft contrast, subtle highlight rolloff, realistic dynamic range, and balanced saturation. Aim for an authentic professional photograph with high detail, natural lighting, realistic depth, polished editorial quality.
